async def act(page):
    # Click the 'Epoch & Drift Benchmark' link to navigate to the homepage where the Archives widget might be located
    home_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Epoch & Drift Benchmark", exact=True)
    await home_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # Now, on the homepage, look for the 'Archives' widget
    # Check for a complementary or region section with text containing 'Archives'
    archives_widget = page.get_by_role("complementary").filter(has=page.get_by_text("Archives", exact=False))
    if await archives_widget.count() > 0:
        # Within the archives widget, find and click the link for 'April 2023'
        april_2023_link = archives_widget.get_by_role("link", name="April 2023", exact=True)
        await april_2023_link.click()
        await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    else:
        # If not found in complementary, check region sections
        region_widget = page.get_by_role("region").filter(has=page.get_by_text("Archives", exact=False))
        if await region_widget.count() > 0:
            april_2023_link = region_widget.get_by_role("link", name="April 2023", exact=True)
            await april_2023_link.click()
            await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
        else:
            # Archives widget not found on homepage; print a message (task should be possible, so this might indicate an issue)
            print("Archives widget not found on the homepage.")
